metadata.name: MIDI MP3 Tool
metadata.description: Tool registry integration for generating MIDI files from text/string input and synthesizing them to MP3 audio using FluidSynth and SoundFonts
metadata.author: automated-developer

globalContext.inputFormats: ABC notation, note sequence DSL, JSON note array

goals.objective: Initialize Rust project with dependencies for MIDI generation, FluidSynth synthesis, and MP3 encoding

success: Cargo.toml includes midi_file, fluidsynth bindings, and mp3 encoder
Feature flags for optional ABC notation support

constraints: FluidSynth system library required (libfluidsynth-dev on Linux)

context.cargoToml:
[dependencies]
midi_file = "0.1"
rust-music = "0.1" # optional high-level API
fluidlite-rs = "0.1" # or fluidsynth-rs
mp3lame-encoder = "0.1"
hound = "3.5"
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
regex = "1.0"

goals.objective: Define and document supported string input formats for music notation including note sequences and ABC notation

success: Note sequence DSL defined: C4:q D4:q E4:h (note:duration)
ABC notation subset supported for melody input
acceptance: Duration units: whole, half, quarter, eighth, sixteenth (w, h, q, e, s)

constraints: Support standard note names: C, D, E, F, G, A, B with sharps (#) and flats (b)
Octave range: 0-8 (C4 = middle C, MIDI note 60)

context.noteSequenceDSL: tempo:120 C4:q D4:q E4:q F4:q | G4:h A4:h | C5:w

goals.objective: Implement parser for note sequence DSL converting string input to internal note representation

success: Note struct: pitch (MIDI number), duration (ticks), velocity, start_time
Supports ties and dots for extended durations
acceptance: Parses tempo, time signature, notes, rests
Error messages indicate position of parse failure

constraints: Use regex or nom for parsing
Default velocity: 80, default duration: quarter note

context.noteStruct: struct Note { pitch: u8, duration_ticks: u32, velocity: u8, start_tick: u32 }

goals.objective: Implement ABC notation parser for traditional music input format

success: Supports X: (index), T: (title), M: (meter), K: (key), L: (note length)
Parses note sequences with octave markers and accidentals
Handles bar lines, repeats (basic), and ties

constraints: Use abc2midi as reference for edge cases

context.abcFields: X: (tune number), T: (title), M: (meter e.g. 4/4), L: (default note length), K: (key signature), Q: (tempo)
context.abcNotes: CDEFGABc (uppercase = below middle C, lowercase = above), apostrophe = octave up, comma = octave down

goals.objective: Implement MIDI file generation from parsed note data using midi_file crate

success: Writes valid Standard MIDI File (SMF) format 0 or 1
Configurable: tempo, time signature, instrument (program change)
acceptance: Output plays correctly in standard MIDI players
Tempo changes embedded as meta events
Note on/off events properly paired with correct timing

constraints: Use midi_file crate for SMF generation

context.midiConfig: struct MidiConfig { tempo_bpm: u16, time_sig: (u8, u8), instrument: u8, ppqn: u16 }

goals.objective: Implement SoundFont download and cache management for MIDI synthesis
Implement MIDI to WAV rendering using FluidSynth with SoundFont synthesis

acceptance: Output WAV plays correctly in audio players
All MIDI instruments render with SoundFont patches

constraints: Alternatively shell out to fluidsynth CLI

context.renderConfig: struct RenderConfig { sample_rate: u32, gain: f32, reverb: bool, chorus: bool }

goals.objective: Implement WAV to MP3 encoding for final audio output

success: encode_wav_to_mp3(wav_path, mp3_path, config) creates MP3 file
acceptance: Output MP3 plays in standard players

constraints: Use mp3lame-encoder crate or shell to lame CLI

context.encoderConfig: struct Mp3Config { bitrate: u16, vbr: bool, quality: u8 }

goals.objective: Implement end-to-end pipeline: string input → MIDI → WAV → MP3

success: Auto-detects input format (note DSL, ABC, JSON)
Creates intermediate MIDI and WAV (optionally retained)
acceptance: Pipeline handles inputs of any length
Graceful error handling at each stage

constraints: Temp files cleaned up unless retain flag set

context.pipelineSteps: 1. Parse input → 2. Generate MIDI → 3. Render WAV via FluidSynth → 4. Encode MP3 → 5. Cleanup temps
context.synthResult: struct SynthResult { mp3_path: String, midi_path: Option<String>, duration_ms: u64, notes_count: usize }

goals.objective: Define JSON schema for midi_mp3 tool interface with input/output specifications

success: Input schema: action, input_text, input_format, tempo, instrument, soundfont, output_format, output_path
Output schema: mp3_path, midi_path, duration_ms, notes_count
Action types: synthesize, validate_input, list_instruments, list_soundfonts
acceptance: Schema validates with JSON Schema Draft-07
Sensible defaults for all optional parameters

constraints: Support both MP3 and WAV output

context.inputText: Music notation string (note sequence, ABC, or JSON)
context.inputInstrument: GM instrument number 0-127 or name (default: 0 piano)

goals.objective: Implement tool registry handler for JSON request processing

success: handle(input: Value) -> Result<Value, ToolError> dispatches actions
synthesize action generates audio file from text input
validate_input action checks notation syntax without synthesis
list_instruments returns GM instrument names and numbers
acceptance: All actions return valid JSON per schema
Detailed error messages for parse failures

context.entryPoint: pub async fn handle(input: serde_json::Value) -> Result<serde_json::Value, ToolError>
context.errorCodes: INVALID_INPUT, PARSE_ERROR, MIDI_ERROR, SYNTH_ERROR, ENCODE_ERROR, FILE_ERROR

goals.objective: Create CLI binary for standalone midi_mp3 tool invocation

success: midi-mp3 synth 'C4:q D4:q E4:h' -o melody.mp3 generates audio
midi-mp3 synth --abc 'X:1...' -o tune.mp3 for ABC input

context.cliExamples:
midi-mp3 synth 'C4:q D4:q E4:q F4:q G4:w' -o scale.mp3 | midi-mp3 synth --abc 'X:1
T:Test
K:C
CDEF|' -o test.mp3 --tempo 140 | echo 'A4:h B4:h C5:w' | midi-mp3 synth -o output.mp3

goals.objective: Implement General MIDI instrument lookup and preset management

success: Support common aliases (piano, guitar, strings, etc.)
acceptance: Partial name matching (e.g., 'piano' matches 'Acoustic Grand Piano')

constraints: Use standard General MIDI instrument names
Include percussion note names for channel 10

context.gmFamilies: Piano (0-7), Chromatic Percussion (8-15), Organ (16-23), Guitar (24-31), Bass (32-39), Strings (40-47), Ensemble (48-55), Brass (56-63), Reed (64-71), Pipe (72-79), Synth Lead (80-87), Synth Pad (88-95), Synth Effects (96-103), Ethnic (104-111), Percussive (112-119), Sound Effects (120-127)
context.commonAliases: piano=0, epiano=4, guitar=25, bass=33, violin=40, trumpet=56, sax=65, flute=73

goals.objective: Write unit and integration tests for parsers, MIDI generation, and synthesis pipeline

success: Parser tests verify all input formats
MIDI generation tests validate output structure
Error handling tests for malformed input

constraints: Mock FluidSynth for unit tests where possible
Verify audio output via duration/file size

context.testInputSimple: C4:q D4:q E4:q F4:q | G4:h G4:h | C5:w

goals.objective: Write README and API documentation covering input formats, synthesis options, and usage

success: README with installation, quick start, input format reference
Note sequence DSL fully documented with examples
